WITH latest AS (

  FROM retail.FactInventory
  GROUP BY StoreKey, ProductKey
)

LEFT JOIN (SELECT ProductKey,toNullable(ProductName) AS ProductName,ProductSubcategoryKey,BrandName,ColorName,AvailableForSaleDate FROM retail.DimProduct) p ON i.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
GROUP BY i.ProductKey,p.ProductName

interpretations.sql:
WITH last_dates AS (
SELECT CustomerKey,min(DateKey) AS first_date,maxIf(DateKey,DateKey<=toDate('2008-12-31')) AS last_2008,maxIf(DateKey,DateKey<=toDate('2009-12-31')) AS last_2009
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales GROUP BY CustomerKey HAVING first_date<=toDate('2008-12-31')),
states AS (SELECT CustomerKey,
multiIf(dateDiff('month',last_2008,toDate('2008-12-31'))<=6,'活跃',dateDiff('month',last_2008,toDate('2008-12-31'))<=12,'有流失风险','已流失') AS old_state,
multiIf(dateDiff('month',last_2009,toDate('2009-12-31'))<=6,'活跃',dateDiff('month',last_2009,toDate('2009-12-31'))<=12,'有流失风险','已流失') AS new_state FROM last_dates)
SELECT a.old_state,b.new_state,countIf(s.old_state=a.old_state AND s.new_state=b.new_state) AS customers
FROM states s CROSS JOIN (SELECT arrayJoin(['活跃','有流失风险','已流失']) AS old_state) a
CROSS JOIN (SELECT arrayJoin(['活跃','有流失风险','已流失']) AS new_state) b GROUP BY a.old_state,b.new_state

records.text_zh: 以2009年12月31日为观察截止日，按客户的真实首购月份分群，首购次日起7个自然日内的复购率分别是多少？排除观察期不足7天的客户。
records.manual_rationale: 全局首购次日起7天、排未完成观察、月队列明确；D06b。

interpretations.interpretation: 首购次日起7个自然日；截止2009-12-31已完成观察；购买事件=全部行
interpretations.sql:
WITH cohorts AS (SELECT CustomerKey,min(DateKey) AS first_date FROM retail.FactOnlineSales GROUP BY CustomerKey
HAVING addDays(first_date,7)<=toDate('2009-12-31')),
observed AS (SELECT c.CustomerKey AS CustomerKey,c.first_date AS first_date,countDistinctIf(f.SalesOrderNumber,f.DateKey>c.first_date AND f.DateKey<=addDays(c.first_date,7)) AS purchases
FROM cohorts c LEFT JOIN retail.FactOnlineSales f ON c.CustomerKey=f.CustomerKey GROUP BY c.CustomerKey,c.first_date)
SELECT toStartOfMonth(first_date) AS cohort_month,countIf(purchases>0)*100.0/count() AS repurchase_pct, count() AS cohort_customers
FROM observed GROUP BY cohort_month

records.text_zh: 在2009年同店销售下降的门店中，降幅最大的3家门店各自由哪个产品品类拖累最多？列出门店降幅、该品类销售减少额及其占门店总减少额的百分比。
records.manual_rationale: 同店降幅率选店，再按品类销售减少额选最大拖累；A29/D14。

interpretations.interpretation: 遵守企业约定及题干限定口径
interpretations.sql:
WITH totals AS (
SELECT StoreKey,sumIf(SalesAmount,toYear(DateKey)=2008) AS sales_2008,sumIf(SalesAmount,toYear(DateKey)=2009) AS sales_2009
FROM retail.FactSales WHERE toYear(DateKey) IN (2008,2009) GROUP BY StoreKey HAVING sales_2008>0 AND sales_2009>0 AND sales_2009<sales_2008),
categories AS (SELECT f.StoreKey AS StoreKey,if(pc.ProductCategoryKey=0,NULL,pc.ProductCategoryName) AS category,
sumIf(f.SalesAmount,toYear(f.DateKey)=2008)-sumIf(f.SalesAmount,toYear(f.DateKey)=2009) AS decline_amount, sumIf(f.SalesAmount,toYear(f.DateKey)=2008) AS category_base_sales
FROM retail.FactSales f LEFT JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON f.ProductKey=p.ProductKey
LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey=ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc ON ps.ProductCategoryKey=pc.ProductCategoryKey WHERE toYear(f.DateKey) IN (2008,2009) GROUP BY f.StoreKey,category)
SELECT t.StoreKey,s.StoreName,(t.sales_2008-t.sales_2009)*100.0/t.sales_2008 AS decline_pct,
c.category,c.decline_amount,c.decline_amount*100.0/(t.sales_2008-t.sales_2009) AS contribution_pct, t.sales_2008-t.sales_2009 AS store_decline_amount, c.decline_amount*100.0/nullIf(c.category_base_sales,0) AS category_decline_pct
FROM totals t JOIN categories c ON t.StoreKey=c.StoreKey LEFT JOIN retail.DimStore s ON t.StoreKey=s.StoreKey
ORDER BY decline_pct DESC,decline_amount DESC

records.text_zh: 2008年销售额处于前10%的产品，在2009年合计贡献了多少销售额，占2009年全部销售额的百分之多少？
records.manual_rationale: 产品前10%可取P90值阈值或ceil(N*10%)排名；不是营收累计前10%。A21固定2009完整分母。

interpretations.interpretation: 按2008年销售额的精确线性插值P90阈值选产品，保留阈值并列
interpretations.sql:
WITH products AS (
SELECT ProductKey,sumIf(SalesAmount,toYear(DateKey)=2008) AS base_sales,
sumIf(SalesAmount,toYear(DateKey)=2009) AS future_sales,countIf(toYear(DateKey)=2008) AS base_rows
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales WHERE toYear(DateKey) IN (2008,2009) GROUP BY ProductKey),
total AS (SELECT sum(SalesAmount) AS total_sales FROM retail.FactOnlineSales WHERE toYear(DateKey)=2009)
SELECT p.ProductKey AS ProductKey,p.base_sales AS base_sales,p.future_sales AS sales_amount,t.total_sales AS total_sales,
p.future_sales*100.0/nullIf(t.total_sales,0) AS share_pct FROM products p CROSS JOIN total t WHERE p.base_rows>0

records.manual_rationale: 店内最畅销可指销量或销售额；全公司排名明确按销售额，竞赛与稠密排名未被D18唯一限定。

r.product_sales AS product_sales,r.global_sales AS global_sales,toUInt64(0) AS global_rank FROM rank_domain r

records.text_zh: 对2009年购买过商品的客户，客户年收入与当年消费额的Pearson相关系数，在全体客户和各职业内分别是多少？列出各组客户数。范围标签统一使用“全体”和“职业内”；全体行的职业列为空，职业内行使用数据中的职业名称。
records.manual_rationale: Pearson、当年消费、全体和职业组、样本人数已明确；A36不擅自剔离群客户。

interpretations.interpretation: 遵守企业约定及题干限定口径；购买事件=全部行（含纯退货行）

FROM spend f LEFT JOIN retail.DimCustomer c ON f.CustomerKey=c.CustomerKey WHERE c.YearlyIncome IS NOT NULL)

records.text_zh: 用2009年月度销售额的变异系数比较各产品品类的经营波动，列出各品类的月均销售额和变异系数。
records.manual_rationale: 变异系数的总体或样本标准差均可；L1plus未规定标准差分母。D12规定月均。

interpretations.interpretation: 声明总体标准差（除以12）
interpretations.sql:
WITH monthly AS (SELECT if(pc.ProductCategoryKey=0,0,pc.ProductCategoryKey) AS category_key,
if(pc.ProductCategoryKey=0,NULL,pc.ProductCategoryName) AS category,toMonth(f.DateKey) AS m,sum(f.SalesAmount) AS sales_amount
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f LEFT JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON f.ProductKey=p.ProductKey
LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey=ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc ON ps.ProductCategoryKey=pc.ProductCategoryKey WHERE toYear(f.DateKey)=2009 GROUP BY category_key,category,m),
categories AS (SELECT category_key,any(category) AS category FROM monthly GROUP BY category_key),
series AS (SELECT c.category_key AS category_key,c.category AS category,n.number+1 AS m,x.sales_amount AS sales_amount
FROM categories c CROSS JOIN numbers(12) n LEFT JOIN monthly x ON c.category_key=x.category_key AND n.number+1=x.m)
SELECT category,avg(sales_amount) AS monthly_sales_amount,stddevPop(sales_amount)/nullIf(avg(sales_amount),0) AS coefficient_ratio
FROM series GROUP BY category_key,category

records.text_zh: 2009 年哪 10 对 Contoso 产品最常出现在同一个订单里？给出它们的共同订单数和提升度。
records.manual_rationale: 共同订单数明确，提升度的概率总体可为全部线上订单或至少含一款Contoso的订单；L1plus未规定lift总体。

interpretations.interpretation: 提升度的概率总体为2009年全部线上订单
interpretations.sql:
WITH baskets AS (
SELECT f.SalesOrderNumber,groupUniqArrayIf(f.ProductKey,p.BrandName='Contoso') AS products
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f LEFT JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON f.ProductKey=p.ProductKey
WHERE toYear(f.DateKey)=2009 GROUP BY f.SalesOrderNumber),
first_product AS (SELECT SalesOrderNumber,products,arrayJoin(products) AS product1_key FROM baskets),
pairs AS (SELECT product1_key,product2_key,count() AS both_orders FROM first_product ARRAY JOIN products AS product2_key
WHERE product1_key<product2_key GROUP BY product1_key,product2_key),
marginal AS (SELECT product1_key AS ProductKey,count() AS product_orders FROM first_product GROUP BY product1_key),
total AS (SELECT count() AS all_orders FROM baskets)
SELECT x.product1_key AS product1_key,toNullable(a.ProductName) AS product1_name,
x.product2_key AS product2_key,toNullable(b.ProductName) AS product2_name,
x.both_orders AS common_orders,x.both_orders*1.0*t.all_orders/(ma.product_orders*mb.product_orders) AS lift_ratio
FROM pairs x JOIN marginal ma ON x.product1_key=ma.ProductKey
JOIN marginal mb ON x.product2_key=mb.ProductKey CROSS JOIN total t
LEFT JOIN retail.DimProduct a ON x.product1_key=a.ProductKey
LEFT JOIN retail.DimProduct b ON x.product2_key=b.ProductKey
ORDER BY common_orders DESC LIMIT 10

FROM pairs x JOIN marginal ma ON x.product1_key=ma.ProductKey
